name: Cafe Lota
notes: Regional Indian at the Crafts Museum. Sabudana popcorn, palak patta chaat.

name: Hauz Khas Village
notes: Deer park + the fort ruins by the lake. Go before sunset.

name: Lodhi Art District
notes: Open-air street art across the Lodhi Colony blocks.

name: Champa Gali
notes: Lane of cafes in Saidulajab. Try Jugmug Thela.

name: Majnu Ka Tilla
notes: Tibetan colony. Laphing, butter tea, AMA cafe.

name: Sunder Nursery
notes: Heritage park next to Humayun's Tomb. Picnic spot.

name: Paranthe Wali Gali
notes: Old Delhi parathas; combine with Jama Masjid.

name: Khan Market
notes: Bookshops (Bahrisons, Faqir Chand) and Big Chill.

name: Yamuna Biodiversity Park
notes: Wetlands and birding, best in winter mornings.
